chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Hariz, from Bukayr, from one of the two عليهما السلام, that he said:
"Whoever fabricates a false accusation against a Muslim shall be flogged eighty lashes, whether he is a Jew, a Christian, or a slave."

key_terms.افْتَرَى: fabricated or invented a false accusation
key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty, referring to the number of lashes
key_terms.ضُرِبَ: was to be flogged or struck as a legal punishment
key_terms.عَبْدًا: a slave, mentioned as one category of offender
key_terms.مُسْلِمٍ: a Muslim whose honor and legal protection are violated by slander
key_terms.نَصْرَانِيًّا: a Christian, mentioned as one category of offender
key_terms.يَهُودِيًّا: a Jew, mentioned as one category of offender

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for falsely accusing a Muslim in Shi'i hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal punishment for slanderously fabricating an accusation against a Muslim. It indicates that the prescribed hadd applies regardless of whether the offender is a Jew, a Christian, or a slave.
